name: RelayTV
description: Turns a Linux box connected to a television into a local playback endpoint. Send links from a phone, browse Jellyfin or Emby libraries, play IPTV channels, and drive playback from Home Assistant or HTTP (alternative to Chromecast). ([Source Code](https://github.com/mcgeezy/relaytv), [Clients](https://github.com/mcgeezy/relaytv-android)) `GPL-3.0` `Docker`
